notes: WArmy 0.4.20 — acceptance-feedback round (10 items): first-run screens no longer allow background/text selection (inputs and mnemonic words stay copyable); the running-avatar effect is redesigned as a softer flowing-light sweep with diffusion ripple while staying clearly visible; the in-progress thinking/execution block now reliably stays expanded while running and collapses after the final reply; fixed chat viewport jumping to the top when sending a message / starting execution / final reply (top-pinning removed: follow-bottom or keep position, new user message always returns to bottom); the appearance-model list no longer mixes in bundled defaults (builtin-default / RobotExpressive) and filters by 2D/3D form; the model-folder hint sits on one line with a folder icon and switches text with the 2D/3D toggle; the redundant format list line is removed; the actions area is one hint line + folder icon + a 3-row scrolling grid (click toggles enable with selected state, right-click menu: trigger word / disable / delete), and the separate trigger-word section is removed; fixed 3D models being completely invisible (the GLB render branch never called renderer.render) and stale canvas stacking, and redrew the 2D character as a cuter chibi; the mimic sub-window settings button now uses the same icon as the main rail. 10 new UI strings in all 27 locales, 7 obsolete keys removed. Verified by the full suite: 78 gates + 6 real-machine feature probes x 3 consecutive clean rounds. The in-app updater downloads only changed blocks with unchanged SHA-256 verification.
